mentions.name: Web-based self-contained encryption/decryption tool (ts-cms-ep-sfx)
mentions.description: A web-based, self-contained encryption/decryption tool for easily sharing files with maximum compatibility (a ZIP archive inside a CMS payload) and minimum requirements.
mentions.source_excerpt:
In addition, trying to move a side-side project to Svelte 5:

    * A web-based self-contained encryption/decryption tool (https://github.com/ApelegHQ/ts-cms-ep-sfx) --- Created to easily share files with maximum compatibility (ZIP archive inside a CMS payload) and minimum requirements.
